Only one real three-frame RGB source plus separate RGB-D smoke; five cleaning fixtures are synthetic. Repeats are not independent videos.
WiLoR versus SAM2/HaMeR, different preprocessing, implicit native frame/coordinate metadata and extra outputs; no same-model/output speed ratio.
EgoWorld fixture uses known instance IDs/handedness mapping; native WiLoR predicts handedness. Not a fair accuracy comparison.
Native WiLoR declares CUDA support; this reference environment is CPU-only Torch and follows native CPU fallback, not proof that Data-Juicer is CPU-only.
EgoWorld scene and RGB-D world run successfully; corresponding native MoGe/MegaSAM/robot tasks were not run. The full strict C1 matrix and B2 repeats remain pending.
Observed native CPU hand pipeline is faster in this tiny pilot. Does not establish framework speed or server scaling.
NVML values are whole-device, including desktop baseline/other processes. Process-tree RSS can double-count shared pages.
No C2 recovery comparison or independent holdout annotation-quality evaluation. Fast3R production randomness not frozen.
